name: Talismandrake Heat
text:
P
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except Pyro Monsters. You can target 1 DARK Pyro Fusion Monster in your GY; return it to the Extra Deck, and if you do, return this card to the hand. You can only use this effect of “Talismandrake Heat” once per turn.
E
Gains 200 ATK for each “Talismandrake” Spell/Trap you control that is equipped to a monster. If you control a DARK Pyro monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During the Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK Pyro Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field as material. You can only use each effect of "Talismandrake Heat" once per turn.

name: Ghostrick Djinn
text: Cannot be Normal Summoned, unless you control a "Ghostrick" monster. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. If you Set a monster(s) or Special Summon a "Ghostrick" monster(s): You can Special Summon this card from your hand in face-down Defense Position. If this card is flipped face-up: You can declare 1 Level between 1 and 4, then target any number of "Ghostrick" monsters you control; they become that declared Level. An Xyz Monster with this card as material gains this effect. ● Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change it to face-down Defense Position.

name: Gaia, the Iron Clad Knight
text: (This card is always treated as a "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster.) If there is a face-up Dragon monster on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can target 1 Dragon monster on the field or in either GY; banish this card and that target, and if you do, Special Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that specifically lists a "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster as Fusion Material, and if you do that, it gains 2600 ATK until the End Phase. If another "Gaia The Fierce Knight" monster(s) is banished while this card is banished: You can shuffle this card into the Deck; return that banished monster(s) to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Gaia, The Iron Clad Knight" once per turn.

name: Shining Brigade - Heartbeat Division
text:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: you can Special Summon 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your hand. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you use this effect, except "Shining Brigade" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Heartbeat Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect: You can detach 1 material from this card; banish that monster.

name: Dysmandr, the Depraevity of Worlds
text:
(This card is always treated as a "Stellar" card.)
1 Rank/Level 9 LIGHT Dragon Monster + 1 "Protogenic Essence Token"
Cannot be destroyed by battle, also, this card gains 3000 ATK/DEF. During the Main Phase, or, if this card is Fusion Summoned: You can place 1 "Dysmandr" Continuous Spell/Trap from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. During the End Phase, if a monster was destroyed this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Protogenic Essence Token" (Galaxy/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), but that Token cannot be used as Link Material. You can only use each effect of "Dysmandr, the Depraevity of Worlds" once per turn.

name: Evander Coldwater & the Nautical Abyss
text:
2+ Level 1 Aqua monsters
Gains 500 ATK for each "Nautica" card attached to it as Xyz Material. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; return it to the hand, then, immediately after this effect resolves, your opponent Normal or Special Summons 1 monster from their hand in Attack Position, but its ATK becomes 0.

name: Shining Brigade - Loving Division
text:
During the Main Phase: You can target 1 "Shining Brigade" card in your GY; banish it, and if you do, Special Summon this card from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Loving Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn: You can Set 1 "Shining Brigade" Trap from your Deck, GY, or banishment (that Set card can be activated this turn).

name: Gravinity Spherix
text:
1 "Gravinity" Tuner + 1+ Cyberse Synchro Monsters
This card's Synchro Summon cannot be negated. If a player would Normal or Special Summon a monster (except from the Spell & Trap Zone), place that monster face-up in its owner's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap instead, and if you do, it gains the following effect (even if this card leaves the field).
● During the Main Phase, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can Special Summon this card, ignoring its summoning conditions, then, if this card is an Xyz Monster, you can attach the minimum number of monsters that can be used for this card's Xyz Summon from your GY to this card as material.
Each time a Monster Card is Special Summoned from the Spell/Trap Zone, place 1 Gravity Counter on this card (max. 2). (Quick Effect): You can remove 2 Gravity Counters from this card; shuffle 1 monster your opponent controls and 1 "Gravinity" Monster Card in the same column into their owners' Deck/Extra Deck.

name: Shining Brigade - Forward Division
text:
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Shining Brigade" Spell from your Deck or GY to your hand. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you use this effect, except "Shining Brigade" monsters. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Forward Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Each turn, negate the effect of your opponent's first Spell Card or effect that resolves.

name: Shining Brigade - Flowering Division
text:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by shuffling 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your banishment or GY into the Deck. You can only Special Summon "Shining Brigade - Flowering Division" once per turn this way. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn: You can add 1 "Shining Brigade" card from your GY or banishment to your hand.

name: Ghostrick Oni
text:
2+ Level 1 monsters, including a "Ghostrick" monster
Gains 200 DEF for each "Ghostrick" card in your GY. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can attach 1 "Ghostrick" card from your Deck to this card, and if you do, immediately after this effect resolves Xyz Summon 1 Rank 3 or lower "Ghostrick" monster you control using this card as material (transfer this card's materials to that monster), also, it can activate its effects as Quick Effects this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Ghostrick" monster you control or in your GY; monsters your opponent controls lose ATK equal to the ATK of that monster.

name: Killamity Goldenrod
text:
If you control no monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Killamity" Spell/Trap from your Deck. If this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Rank 12 Xyz Monster you control; attach this card to that card as material, then you can make it gain the following effect.
● You can detach 1 material from this card; Special Summon 1 "Killamity" monster from your Deck with a different Attribute from the detached monster.
You can only use each effect of "Killamity Goldenrod" once per turn.

name: Killamity Pine
text:
If you control no monsters, or you control a Level/Rank 12 monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then, if it is your turn, you can, immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Rank 12 Xyz Monster using monsters you control as material. If a Rank 12 Xyz Monster leaves the field because of your opponent's card effect: You can Special Summon this card and 1 Rank 12 Xyz Monster from your GY, but negate their effects. You can only use each effect of "Killamity Pine" once per turn. A Rank 12 Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each.

name: Killamity Crimson
text:
If you control no monsters or you control a Level/Rank 12 monster: You can reveal 1 Rank 12 Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 12 Xyz Monsters. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Killamity" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Killamity Crimson". You can only use each effect of "Killamity Crimson" once per turn. A Rank 12 Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

name: Killamity Azure
text:
You can discard 1 card; Special Summon this card from your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can return 1 monster your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Killamity Azure" once per turn. A Rank 12 Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Up to twice per turn, if a Level/Rank 12 monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

name: Killamity Ash
text:
You can send 1 Level 12 monster from your Deck to your GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Rank 12 Xyz Monsters. If this card is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Killamity" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use each effect of "Killamity Ash" once per turn. A Rank 12 Xyz Monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● This card is unaffected by your opponent's non-activated effects.

name: Ruby, Killamity Convergence
text:
2+ Level 12 monsters 
Gains 200 ATK/DEF for each material attached to it. If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can negate the effects of all cards your opponent controls. During the Main or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can attach up to 4 cards, including 1 "Killamity" monster, from your hand, field and/or GY (Max. 1 on the field) to this card as material, then you can attach up to 1 Monster, Spell and/or Trap from your opponent's field and GY to this card as material (Max. 1 on the field). You can only use each effect of "Ruby, Killamity Convergence" once per turn.

name: Azrynior, the Abundaence of Purity
text:
(This card is always treated as a "Stellaer" card.)
1 Rank/Level 9 LIGHT Dragon Monster + 1 "Protogenic Essence Token"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also, this card gains 3000 ATK/DEF. During the Main Phase, or, if this card is Fusion Summoned: You can place 1 "Azrynior" Continuous Spell/Trap from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone. During the End Phase, if a "Protogenic Essence Token" was Tributed this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "Protogenic Essence Token" (Galaxy/LIGHT/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0), but that Token cannot be used as Link Material. You can only use each effect of "Azrynior, the Abundaence of Purity" once per turn.

name: Chaos Honest
text:
2 LIGHT and/or DARK Effect Monsters
While face-up on the field, this card is also DARK-Attribute. During the Damage Step, when a LIGHT or DARK monster this card points to battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card to the GY; apply the following effects, in sequence, based on the Attributes of the materials used for this card's Link Summon.
● LIGHT: That monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.
● DARK: That opponent's monster loses ATK equal to its own ATK, until the end of this turn.

name: Crewal Cursed Sea
text: 3+ Level 4 Zombie monsters. Once per turn you can also Xyz Summon "Crewal Cursed Sea" the turn 2 or more monsters have been Special Summoned from your Spell & Trap Zone by using a Zombie monster you control as material. If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; place it in your Spell & Trap Zone. Gains 1000 ATK for each monster card in your Spell & Trap Zone. Your opponent cannot target this card for attacks or with card effects. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Spell & Trap Zone. You can only use each effect of "Crewal Cursed Sea" once per turn.

name: Polemistis gia Ataxia
text:
2 Level 1 or higher "Protogenic Essence Tokens"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing the Required Materials you control while you control "To Proto Ataxia" (You do not use "Polymerization"). If a monster(s) loses ATK/DEF, this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount lost. This card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can add to your hand or send to the GY 1 "Ataxia" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Polemistis gia Ataxia" once per turn.

name: Shining Brigade - Joyous Division
text:
When a "Shining Brigade" monster is Special Summoned: You can Special Summon this card from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Joyous Division" once per turn. A "Shining Brigade" monster that has this card as material gains the following effect.
● Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can roll a 6-sided die; banish cards from your opponent's GY up to half the number rolled (rounded up).

name: Digita Leet
text: You can target 1 Cyberse monster you control; Special Summon this card from your hand, then, if that monster has more than 0 ATK/DEF, banish it. (Quick Effect): Fusion Summon 1 Cyberse Fusion Monster using Cyberse monsters from your hand or field as Fusion Material, including this card. The Fusion Summoned monster gains 1000 ATK/DEF for each material with 0 ATK and DEF (or no DEF) used. You can only activate each effect of "Digita Leet" once per turn.

name: Jelly Miss of the Grand Blue
text: If you control a "Grand Blue" monster: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then if you control "Umi", you can negate the effects of 1 face-up card your opponent controls, also, this card gains 800 ATK/DEF. If this card is in your GY: You can Fusion Summon 1 "Grand Blue" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck by shuffling the Fusion Materials listed on it into the Deck, including this card. You can only use each effect of "Jelly Miss of the Grand Blue" once per turn.

name: Lord of the Pyre
text: 2 Pyro monsters This card and monster it points to cannot be Tributed or used as Link material, except for the Summon of a Pyro monster. Monsters this card points to cannot attack other Pyro monsters. While this card points to a Pyro monster, it gains 1000 ATK for each monster this card points to, also it cannot be destroyed by battle. If a "Pyre" Spell card is banished: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only control 1 "Lord of the Pyre".

name: Virtua Leet
text: /EFFECTI 2+ Cyberse monsters with 0 ATK/DEF This card gains effects based on the number of materials with 0 ATK and DEF (or no DEF) used for its Fusion Summon. 0 This card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects. y: This card cannot be targeted by your opponents card effects. O V: This card is unaffected by card effects. If this card was Fusion Summoned this turn, you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of the turn. 5: Once while face-up on the field: You can banish 1 Cyberse monster from your GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
